# authwise_provider_passkey (Data Source)

The passkey provider signs nobody in without an enabled WebAuthn factor on the realm: kit refuses the first sign-in with "realm offers no webauthn factor". Declare an `authwise_factor` of type `webauthn` beside it. Builds a ProviderPasskey config and exposes its google.protobuf.Any encoding as `any`. Makes no API calls.
